units.source_text: 名人这些谈话，是《东京日日新闻》黑崎记者记录下来的。

en.t: These remarks by the Master were recorded by reporter Kurosaki of the Tokyo Nichinichi Shimbun.

units.source_text: 谈话里提到的“今天”，是指十一月九日。

en.t: The "today" mentioned in the remarks refers to November 9.

units.source_text: 名人的告别赛于八月十四日在箱根暂停之后，正好在第三个月又能继续参战了。

en.t: After the Master's farewell match was suspended at Hakone on August 14, he was able to resume play exactly in the third month afterward.

units.source_text: 临近冬天，对局地点改在伊东的暖香园。

en.t: As winter approached, the match venue was changed to Dankoen in Ito.
